Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished transparent 3D illustration for a premium Russian real estate agency service card, specifically apartment rental.
Primary request: a carefully detailed architectural miniature of a bright modern rental apartment living room and entrance hall, with a realistic silver apartment key and one pale sky-blue unbranded rounded key tag placed naturally in the foreground. Create a new composition, not a copy of a full apartment floor plan.
Subject and composition: an elegant isometric cutaway corner apartment on one thin rectangular stone floor slab; left wall tall daylight window with slim dark graphite mullions and sheer white curtain; at the back a clear entry door with silver handle and a modest built-in light neutral gray storage cabinet; in the room a tactile white two-seat sofa, one pale gray armchair, round white stone coffee table with two books and a small ceramic cup, subtle finely woven cool-gray rug, tiny natural green potted plant and one medium olive tree. The key and blue tag are outside the model at the nearest front corner, together, believable stainless steel forms, gently prominent but not gigantic. A restrained, coherent lived-in apartment composition with correct perspective and furniture proportions. No bedroom and no full multi-room floor plan; this must remain visibly distinct from a buying-property card.
Style: refined high-end architectural visualization / realistic crafted 3D miniature, soft tangible material detail, crisp architectural edges and very subtle soft contact shadow. Matches an existing white/pearl-gray isometric apartment miniature illustration and an existing property valuation stationery illustration.
Materials and colors: porcelain white plaster, white linen, neutral ash-gray timber (no warm tan), light neutral gray stone and fabric, brushed silver metal, small muted sky-blue accents on key tag and cushion only; natural green leaves are allowed. Bright neutral daylight from upper left, natural highlights, legible fine details, clean white balance. Absolutely no overall blue tint, cyan cast, beige/brown warmth, dark smoky overlay, haze or desaturation filter.
Framing: landscape 4:3 canvas, elevated isometric view about 30 degrees, entire object and key fully visible with a comfortable transparent margin on every side, visual silhouette occupying about 88 percent of the canvas width and height. The composition is intended to sit in the right half of a 628 by 410 web card, so it must read clearly and remain attractive when shown approximately 330 pixels wide.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no opaque white or colored background, no studio backdrop, no checkerboard baked in. Only subtle transparent contact shadows beneath the miniature and key.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no labels, no people, no hands, no decorative floating symbols, no circular pedestal.
